name: Bruno Glening
original_name: ブルーノ・グレーニング
source:
The new royal physician.

"...sports white hair and unnaturally shiny glasses, which is how you know he's eeeeeeeevil. He's Georik's sociopathic boss, and also some sort of doctor, although personally, I wouldn't let him give me a band-aid if I were bleeding to death in the gutter."

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
